Vectorize a function with broadcasting

Source: R/numpy_array2.R
jnp_vectorize.Rd

Port of jnp.vectorize: the function is mapped with vmap() over the broadcast leading dimensions of its arguments. With a generalized ufunc signature such as "(n,m),(m)->(n)" the trailing core dimensions are passed whole.

Usage

jnp_vectorize(pyfunc, excluded = integer(0), signature = NULL)

Arguments

pyfunc

Function to vectorize.

excluded

Positions (0-based) or names of arguments passed through unchanged. Named arguments that are not excluded are ignored, as upstream.

signature

Optional generalized ufunc signature.

Value

The vectorized function. Multiple outputs are returned (and must be returned by pyfunc) as an unnamed list.
